_note: Live job listings: two SociableKIT widgets (LinkedIn and Indeed). The embed numbers come from BRG's SociableKIT account (Clayton, 27 Nov). Widget scripts are added by brgwJobs() in brgw.js, never written into the page.

sub.label: Intro line
sub.doc: One or two sentences under the heading. Empty hides it.
sub.default: Every opening we have, straight from LinkedIn and Indeed. Pick one and apply.

linkedin_id.label: LinkedIn embed number
linkedin_id.doc: The number from the SociableKIT LinkedIn jobs embed code: the data-embed-id value, digits only. Empty hides the LinkedIn block.

linkedin_label.label: LinkedIn label
linkedin_label.doc: Small label above the LinkedIn listings. Empty hides it.

indeed_id.label: Indeed embed number
indeed_id.doc: The number from the SociableKIT Indeed jobs embed code: the data-embed-id value, digits only. Empty hides the Indeed block.

indeed_label.label: Indeed label
indeed_label.doc: Small label above the Indeed listings. Empty hides it.

fallback.label: If the listings do not load
fallback.doc: Shown, with a link to LinkedIn, if a listing has not appeared after eight seconds (an ad blocker, a bad connection).
fallback.default: We can't show the listings here right now. See all our openings on

section_color.label: Section color
section_color.doc: The flat color behind this section. "As designed" keeps white.

section_text.label: Section text color
section_text.doc: Automatic picks dark or light words, whichever reads better on the color above.

section_color_custom.label: Section color — custom
section_color_custom.doc: Used only when Section color is Custom.
